text: Apart from nice clean design not much to praise for. I paid subscription to have access to more habit categories for 1 month but I have stopped using it after 2 days. Very slow loading of habits, switching between days overview is painfully słow and buggy, often not showing full list od them, or any at all. After completing habit set for 3 times a week it is automatically removed from list no no flexibility to do better possibile.
author: Ada Neu
